# XWork Technologies LLC — Platform & Products

> XWork Technologies LLC builds open, secure, and cloud-neutral AI workspace software connecting models, autonomous agents, engineering tools, and enterprise data.

## Core Products

### XWorkmate
- **Category**: Unified AI Workspace & Multi-Agent Orchestration
- **URL**: https://xworktech.com/products/xworkmate
- **Description**: Connects LLMs (via LiteLLM routing), autonomous agents (OpenClaw multi-session runtime), and specialized engineering skills into durable project threads that deliver tangible code, documents, and assets.
- **Platforms**: macOS, Windows, Linux, Android, Web
- **Repositories**: https://github.com/ai-workspace-lab/xworkmate-app, https://github.com/ai-workspace-lab/xworkmate-bridge

### XConnect
- **Category**: AI Workspace Zero-Trust Connector & Acceleration
- **URL**: https://xworktech.com/products/xconnect
- **Description**: Fast, secure, and resilient global connectivity providing zero-trust tunneling between local development workspaces and cloud/edge inference nodes.
- **Platforms**: macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS, Android
- **Repositories**: https://github.com/ai-workspace-xstream/xconnect-app

### Open Platform & Global Mesh
- **Category**: Cloud-Neutral Infrastructure & Edge Mesh
- **URL**: https://xworktech.com/products/open-platform
- **Description**: Declarative infrastructure-as-code, GitOps workflows, and out-of-band management overlay across multi-cloud VPS providers.
- **Repositories**: https://github.com/ai-workspace-infra/global-mesh
